nom: Peach Slices Snail Rescue Blemish Busting Toner

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily/acne-prone skin generally report the toner is lightweight, mattifies without clogging pores, though one notes it feels too heavy under foundation.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as strongly hydrating, reducing the tight, dry feeling and being one of the few toners that keeps their skin moist.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin repeatedly call it balancing, moisturizing without heaviness, and say it rarely causes breakouts even after years of use.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, reactive, or hypoallergenic skin frequently say it is the rare toner that does not irritate, sting, or worsen redness, though one severely reactive user still broke out.
segments.mature: A couple of older reviewers (50s, or noting increasing oiliness with age) report it stopped breakouts and suits aging, oil-shifting skin.

concerns.aging: One reviewer in her 50s and one noting her skin got oilier with age report the toner stopped breakouts; no reviewer discusses wrinkles or firmness specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong, non-sticky hydration and a hydrated feel the next morning; one reviewer found it less hydrating than expected and layered a hyaluronic acid serum on top.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visible reduction in redness and calming of irritation over daily use, including one with mild rosacea; no negative reports specific to redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with reactive or eczema-adjacent skin report no stinging, burning, or irritation, and one notes it does not aggravate nearby eczema patches.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of dark spots, post-acne marks, and more even tone within one to a few weeks; no dissent noted.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority report fewer breakouts, faster healing of cystic or hormonal acne, and reduced whiteheads; however several reviewers report the opposite — new pimple clusters, giant whiteheads, or worse acne, some describing it as their worst breakout ever.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin say it mattifies and reduces excess oil without over-drying; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Affordable relative to other snail toners
Formula thinner than before, reduced results
Possible allergic reaction with headache and nausea
Layers well under makeup and other skincare

extraits.texte: I just bought & tried this product & not even 2 days later, did it made my skin breakout with small whiteheads & pimples all over (note: I have oily, acne-prone skin - moderate) I've been trying to repair my skin for YEARS & this just set me back again after my face was starting to clear up using La-Roche Posay's Effaclar gel cleanser. I wanted to try a different toner because I was using Thayers & it wasn't doing very much for my acne. I wish I could get my money back, but I already threw my receipt away. Guess I have no choice but to throw this product out. So sad

I LOVED this product at first. It helped with my acne and moistuized my face so well! I couldn't believe how well it worked. After almost exactly a month of using it I experienced severe headache & nausea for 2 weeks. The only thing I had changed was using this toner and when I looked up 1 star reviews for this product A LOT of people were complaining of the same issues. Turns out a lot of people are allerigic to snail mucin. I may just be mildly allergic (since I did not experience these symptoms until after a month of use) but a few people said they didn't get symptoms until 2+ years of using. I SO wish this product did not make me sick because it really did help with my dry acne prone skin. But please please please if you start experiencing nausea, headaches, more anxiety than usual, tight jaw or hives, STOP USING THIS PRODUCT. I also read if you are allergic to shellfish or dust mites you are more likey to be allergic to this product as well. Just be careful with this.

Love Peach Slices' snail line, this toner in particular is great for combo skin because it's moisturizing without being heavy and it does seem to work to help acne fade a little faster. I didn't notice it doing much to prevent acne, but to be fair, my acne is mostly hormonal and I haven't found any skincare products that work super well to prevent it. Sensitive-skin friendly, my skin is so reactive but it handled this really well.

I have reordered this product twice and love how it feels on my skin. I have acne-prone combination skin due to PCOS, and not only does it help my skin heal faster from bumps, it drastically improved the overall texture of my skin. It's not sticky at all like many products with snail mucin and feels very hydrating and soothing. Thank you snails, I am so grateful!

extraits.titre: A STAPLE for my red, dry, acne-prone skin
extraits.texte: Peach slices is a great brand, and this is my favorite product. I'm not generally a toner person, but I've been using this for at least 3 years. My skin is ultra sensitive, dry, and red. This toner is hydrating, gentle, and my skin laps it up. Infinite stars from me!

I used to LOVE this toner. I bought it on a whim once and while I was using it, noticed it's viscosity reminded me of snail mucus. Then I saw it was actually written on the bottle! I really liked it's unique and hydrating feeling and noticed a pretty big improvement on my skin. I bought another bottle when I ran out and noticed this bottle looked a bit different. Usually not a good sign. I tried it and it's a thinner consistency now. Runs like water now. My skin went a bit more downhill since getting my second bottle and it's not making the improvements it did before. Will use what I got but probably won't buy again.

This is the first snail mucin product I have ever used. I normally use Thayers Witch Hazel Toner in the morning prior to makeup but I wanted something more hydrating so I tried this. It's alright but nothing remarkable. It isnt near as hydrating as I was hoping for. I use La Roche Posay Hyaluronic Acid Serum over it and that gives me the hydration boost I like. The snail toner does a little bit (used for 30 days and no change in lightening hyperpigmentation or acne prevention) but if youre looking for a product that will truly give you hydration or acne prevention, I'd look into La Roche Posays serum or Paulas Choice salicyclic wash. Used consistently of course.
